items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the Don Sebesky arrangements... [INTERVIEWEE] Must have it someplace.

ctx.x: It sounds like there’s more people.
Yeah, they overdubbed that little section in there, the Don Sebesky arrangements, and they hooked up “Summer Song” and “Summertime,” and he plays — it’s absolutely gorgeous. Do you have it?
